note: Unit framework is vitest (config vitest.config.mjs): pure logic + component (jsdom) tests under src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}, deterministic, no live server, @/* -> src/* alias. Component tests add `// @vitest-environment jsdom` at the top. E2E remains Playwright (see e2eTool) and needs a running next dev server plus live Clerk/Supabase/Gemini/Groq credentials.
